backgroundDisclosure.title: Location during your shift
backgroundDisclosure.body: PROSM Time collects your location about every 5 minutes to confirm that you are at your work site, even when the app is closed or not in use, but only while you are clocked in. It stops when you clock out. Your location is shared with your organisation's managers and deleted after 30 days. On the next screen, choose "Allow all the time" for this to work.

trackingError.permission: PROSM Time is not allowed to use your location. Allow location ("Allow all the time") in the app settings, then try again. Your clock-in is still recorded.
trackingError.failed: The phone's location service did not start (location may be off). It will be tried again automatically; you can also try now. Your clock-in is still recorded.
